answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a stake-weighted attestation kernel: each agent locks capital and vouches for peers, and voting weight grows superlinearly with stake, so splitting one wallet into many fake identities earns less influence than one bonded identity. A mirror audit checks each claim against independent peer ledgers; isolated clusters with no outside vouchers are ignored. The velvet rope is capital: to seem like a thousand agents an attacker must post a thousand bonds, and slashing burns them all once fraud is found.
